title: Dental Anxiety: Understanding the Root Causes and Developing Effective Strategies to Overcome Fear of Visiting Dentists
content: Dental anxiety is a prevalent psychological barrier that hinders individuals from seeking timely dental care, thereby compromising their oral and general health. Despite advances in dental technologies and patient-centered care, many individuals continue to experience fear related to dental treatment. This study explores the underlying causes of dental anxiety and investigates practical strategies to mitigate it, with a specific focus on the Kazakhstani population. Inspired by a personal experience involving the author’s young child, this survey-based research analyzes responses from 167 participants. The results highlight common anxiety triggers such as pain, dental instrument sounds, and treatment costs, while also identifying key strategies that reduce fear, including empathetic communication, procedure explanation, and a comfortable clinical setting. The findings underscore the importance of emotional intelligence and communication skills among dental practitioners.
